questions.explanationEn:
The Mountain Railways of India are outstanding examples of 
hill railways. The Mountain Railway of India consists of three 
railways: the Darjeeling Himalayan Railway located in the 
foothills of the Himalayas in West Bengal (Northeast India), 
the Nilgiri Mountain Railways located in the Nilgiri Hills 
of Tamil Nadu (South India) and the Kalka Shimla Railway 
located in the Himalayan foothills of Himachal Pradesh 
(Northwest India). The Darjeeling Himalayan Railway, the 
Nilgiri Mountain Railway and the Kalka-Shimla Railway 
have collectively been designated as a UNESCO World 
Heritage Site in 1999.
